changes: Normalized the nakshatra and yoga to Aśvinī and siddhi (aśuninakṣetre = aśvinīnakṣatre, siddhijo ge = siddhiyoge); normalized the weekday reading to budhavāsare.
Changed the purpose field from a corrupt quotation to a short gloss: written for the person on whose behalf (yasyārthena) it was copied.
Notes: added that 'liti manate' might hide a scribe's name (e.g. likhitam Anantena). No person was added because the reading is too uncertain.
Kept no persons, NS 555 and 1435 CE.

date.as_written: samvat 555 vaisāṣaśuklapradipadyāṃ(!) tithau aśuninakṣetre(!) siddhijo gevudavāsarot

purpose: for the person on whose behalf (yasyārthena) it was written; benediction śubham astu sarvadā
notes: The era is not named. It is taken as Nepāla Saṃvat because of the Newari script and the bare 'samvat' (NS 555 ≈ 1435 CE). The date formula is badly corrupted: aśuninakṣetre = aśvinīnakṣatre; siddhijo gevudavāsarot = siddhiyoge budhavāsare. The phrase 'liti manate jasyo 'rthena bhavatu svabham astu sarvvadā' is probably 'likhitam ... yasyārthena, bhavatu śubham astu sarvadā'. 'liti manate' might hide a scribe's name (e.g. likhitam Anantena), but this is too uncertain, so no person is recorded. Title 'pīṭhakāstotra' = Pīṭhikāstotra; 'samastavyaktavyāptinivatuyo' is corrupt.
